newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Inparsa hits highs on results optimism.
newsitem.headline: Inparsa hits highs on results optimism.

text.p: Shares in wood to tourism group Inparsa have hit successive highs due to optimism over the company's results for 1997 and for the first half results of its unit Sonae Industria, analysts said.
"Inparsa is rising due to expectations of good results by Sonae Industria," said one analyst who asked not to be identified.
He forecast that Sonae Industria, a wood products group, would post a net profit of 1.5 billion escudos at the end of 1997. Another analyst forecast a profit of 1.3 billion.
In 1996 Sonae Industria posted a profit after minority interests of 0.45 billion escudos.
Inparsa shares stood at 1,775 escudos, up 67, in volume of 87,490 shares at 1448 GMT.
Earlier today it high an all-time high of 1,785 escudos, 36 percent above the share price at the end of March.
